data.title: 贝塔 · 深夜案前的暗影记事录
data.description: 静谧书房内烛火微明，桌面堆满摊开的原稿纸。贝塔手握精致羽毛笔快速书写，银白短发微散，嘴角带着满溢的崇拜微笑，眼角泪痣更添妩媚。
data.location: cozy private study desk stacked with parchment manuscripts and inkpots
data.action: leaning over desk writing with ornate feather quill, blushing cheeks with a doting passionate smile, tear mole prominent
data.lighting: warm flickering candlelight illuminating soft cleavage and silver hair curls
data.mood: intellectual devotion, passionate fangirl adoration, cozy nighttime intimacy
data.promptProse: Sitting at a candlelit desk surrounded by papers, silver-haired Beta writes passionately with a quill, smiling lovingly.
data.animaCaption: Beta writing the Chronicles of Shadow at her candlelit study desk.
